responsibility: Resolves the value side of fields inside Rust struct construction expressions. This file walks individual struct-expression field nodes, resolving explicit value expressions and shorthand field initializers by lowering the shorthand case to an identifier expression lookup, but it does not validate that the named field exists in the target struct type—that responsibility is deferred to later semantic analysis.
same_name_distinction: Implements the field-level resolver’s behavior for each struct-literal field form, including resolving explicit value expressions and lowering shorthand fields to a synthesized IdentifierExpr lookup. Unlike the matching header, this file contains the concrete field-resolution actions.
